title: cascade-miner experiment ledger entry
description: One line of runs/experiments.jsonl. The pairing fields (seeds, snapshots) and noise_floor exist so a later reader can tell whether two results are comparable; a verdict without them is not evidence.

change.description: The one thing this arm changes versus its control.

snapshots.description: Eval-pool snapshots both arms were scored on; arms scored over different snapshot sets are not paired.

noise_floor.description: The measured same-generator, same-seed score spread the verdict was read against.

supersedes.description: Id of the entry this one updates (e.g. planned -> measured).
